title: CPS PIL GenreFeatureRecord 1.0 (DRAFT, non-normative)
description: Design draft for contract section 7 blockers G2/G4. This file is NOT a contract schema and MUST NOT be copied into backend/songprogram_conformance/schemas/ except by the owner through the authoritative-update workflow. Harmony-group record derived only from already-bound Phase 3/4 records; see docs/song_program_pil_genre_interpretation_draft.md section 3.2.

source_report_hash.description: Hash of the successful Phase 4 PIL report this record is derived from; derivation reuses its bound records and never recomputes with new approximations.

chord_vocabulary_histogram_q31.description: Sparse Q31 histogram over vocabulary ordinals, aggregated from segment-interpretation candidate distributions.

trajectory_histogram_q31.description: Sparse Q31 histogram over trajectory template ordinals from trajectory results.

function_profile_q.description: Closed integer profile from transition feature records; layout declared by the (open) G4 aggregation rule.

harmonic_rhythm_profile_q.description: Integer profile from segment ticks; no floats anywhere in the record.

record_hash.description: Generic cps-artifact-hash/v1 self hash over the canonical body without this field.
